1.consolidated_definition: Parte del apero del caballo, generalmente de cuero, que pasa por debajo de la cola y sujeta la parte trasera de la silla.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Part of the horse's equipment, typically made of leather, that passes under the tail and secures the rear part of the saddle.
